# Health Check — 2026-03-14 00:51 UTC

## Summary: ⚠️ Minor Issues

### PM2 Services (13 total)
- **12 online**, 1 stopped
- ⚠️ **whisper** — stopped (37 restarts). Likely intentional.
- Notable: openclaw-gateway at 784MB RAM, 1112 restarts (just restarted 28s ago)

### Docker Containers (27 total)
- ❌ **langfuse-web** — restart loop ("Restarting (1) 13 seconds ago"). Persistent issue.
- ⚠️ **lidaros-frontend** — unhealthy
- ⚠️ **omiximo-email-automation** — unhealthy
- All other containers running normally

### Disk
- `/` — 69% used (454G/662G) ✅ Under 85% threshold

### Memory
- RAM: 12,094 / 27,532 MB (44%) ✅
- No swap configured

### GPU
- RTX 4090: 41°C, 21W idle, 20,550 / 24,564 MiB VRAM (84%)
- VLLM engine consuming nearly all VRAM — normal for model serving

### OpenClaw Gateway
- Running via PM2 (port 18789), RPC probe OK
- Systemd service shows inactive (PM2 manages it instead)
- Doctor warnings: multiple group chat allowlists empty (groups silently dropped)

## Action Items
- **langfuse-web** restart loop needs investigation (has been ongoing)
- **lidaros-frontend** and **omiximo-email-automation** unhealthy status should be checked
- Group policy warnings are cosmetic unless group chat functionality is needed
